about_the_game:
When our story begins, things aren't looking good for Eleanor Rosewood, one of London's first female lawyers. It's 1898, and young Eleanor is penniless and on the verge of losing her home. The city itself is plagued by a mysterious sickness: animals are being found dead, their blood completely drained.

One night, Eleanor's first client, Professor McDonald, hires her to take on his case. But when a body is found in his home—drained of blood just like the animals—the entire city blames him for the horrific plague. Is he truly responsible? Or is this something far more sinister? It’s up to Eleanor to save her client from the gallows and uncover the truth.

  • Immerse Yourself in a Gothic 19th-Century World

    Feel the late 19th century gothic atmosphere permeate every aspect of the game. Throughout your journey, you'll confront the city's outcasts, dig through graves, fight to maintain your sanity in asylums, hunt down body snatchers, and uncover the secrets of ancient cults. And don't forget to seek the wisdom of the city's enigmatic witch.

    Key Features:

    • Point-and-Click Gothic Adventure: Prepare for a chilling story inspired by classic gothic literature like Dracula and Dr. Jekyll and Mr. Hyde, as well as modern classics like Hellboy.

    • Rich Hand-Drawn World: Dive into the opulent, hand-drawn world of Victorian London. Witness the decay of the 19th century through dynamic visuals.

    • Stunning Art & Storytelling: Watch the narrative unfold with striking hand-drawn cutscenes and character portraits.

    • Engaging Characters: Interact with diverse and intriguing characters from every corner of Victorian society. Every Londoner has their own secrets, hidden lives, and motivations.

    • Eleanor's Journal: Take notes! Record interesting findings in Eleanor’s notebook and refer back to them during your investigation.

    • Investigate & Unravel: Research your notes against Scotland Yard records or city guides. Discover new connections and illuminate the mysteries.

  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DX10, DX11, and DX12-capable GPUs
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
